items.statement_scope: Whole original Problem 3: enumerate lozenge tilings of the equiangular hexagon with cyclic side lengths 2n,2n+3,2n,2n+3,2n,2n+3, after deleting the middle unit triangle of each of its three longer sides. The arbitrary-border-position theorem is retained as the author proof route, not counted as another problem.
